Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Urban population (% of total population)', what value is listed for Bulgaria (BGR) in 2023?

A. 73.7322671584613%
B. 72.7352388396817%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Urban population (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: B
